profile.name: Maya Lindqvist
profile.summary: Data scientist with 5 years of experience in retail and e-commerce. I like turning messy data into models that people actually use.

descriptions: Built churn and CLV models (XGBoost, scikit-learn) that lifted retention campaign ROI by 18%
Designed feature engineering pipelines on 200M-row purchase tables with PySpark and BigQuery
Ran 30+ A/B tests; reported statistical significance and uplift to marketing leads
Productionized models behind an internal API with monitoring and drift alerts (MLOps)
Built Tableau dashboards used weekly by 50+ category managers
Fine-tuned a PyTorch text classifier for NLP on customer reviews
Wrote complex SQL and pandas workflows for weekly reporting
Presented findings to senior stakeholders in plain language
Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch), SQL, Spark, BigQuery, Tableau, Git, Docker
